noul.scope: regime B (judgement against stated criteria) — the regime the p>0.7 canon gate uses

regimeA1_unknowable.warning: noul answers unknowable facts with confidence. Harmless for the canon gate; dangerous as a fact-checker.

score.note: confidence sat at ~0.62 in every case and did not drop to signal the failure

lesson: Discrimination and rank-stability are different properties. Measure the one you depend on.
bugs_in_this_kat: wrong expected value: bucketed unknowable with widely-known, scored correct confidence as overconfidence
meta-question instead of fact: asked 'can it be determined?' which invites a correct confident 'no', then scored it as overconfidence
